grade.notes: The assigned condition is not inferred, and no winner or overall score is produced. Initial and final performance are scored separately: initial is judged only against the pre-audit settlement surface, and post-audit discoveries are not credited to it. The recipient recognized both decisive oracle issues before and after audit retrieval, did not unconditionally accept, and did not overreact to the repaired parser mismatch or unrelated warning. Minor overclaims are flagged where missing test coverage, especially API-retry test coverage, is stated as confirmed rather than unconfirmed. Audit selection was strong for the identity defect and partially aligned for the authority/freshness defect; SH2-R4 was available and potentially decisive for confirming test-case coverage but was not selected. C13-specific future-holdout guidance was not used as an answer key; synthetic H2 mechanics were scored only against the frozen oracle and this record. Response volume, selection breadth, and elapsed time were not treated as proof of cognitive effort.
